content: gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.input-sources current does NOT switch the active input source at runtime on GNOME (unix.stackexchange 316998: value changes, layout stays; mru-sources reads stale - Reddit bkm9kb). Live state lives in GNOME Shell InputSourceManager, not dconf. Workarounds: org.gnome.Shell.Eval calling imports.ui.status.keyboard InputSourceManager activate() (requires unsafe mode on newer GNOME), a small shell extension exposing a D-Bus method (precedent: kevinhwang91/gnome-shell-ibus-switcher), or synthetic Super+Space injection (ydotool). Reading current is also unreliable vs live state.
